rows.traditional: 帶住犬儒嘅態度咁 + V
rows.jyutping: daai3 zyu6 hyun2 jyu4 ge3 taai3 dou6 gam3 V
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something while distrusting people’s motives or ideals.

example.english: They looked at the scandal cynically, saying that every politician was only out for themselves.
example.traditional: 佢哋帶住犬儒嘅態度咁睇呢單醜聞，話個個政客都係為自己。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 daai2 zyu6 hyun2 jyu4 ge3 taai3 dou6 gam3 tai2 ne1 daan1 cau2 man4 waa6 go3 go3 zing3 haak3 dou1 hai6 wai6 zi6 gei2

rows.note: Use this when the cynical manner is expressed through mocking or sarcastic remarks.

example.english: They cynically remarked that donating to charity was only for getting into the newspaper.
example.traditional: 佢冷嘲熱諷咁話，捐錢做善事只係為咗上報紙。
example.jyutping: keoi5 laang5 zaau1 jit6 fung3 gam3 waa6 gyun1 cin2 zou6 sin6 si6 zi2 hai6 wai6 zo2 soeng5 bou3 zi2

rows.note: Use this for a snide, affectedly strange cynical tone, especially in casual speech.

example.english: You don't need to speak cynically like that; they really do want to help.
example.traditional: 你唔使陰陽怪氣咁講，人哋真係想幫手㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 jam1 joeng4 gwaai3 hei3 gam3 gong2 jan4 dei6 zan1 hai6 soeng2 bong1 sau2 gaa3
